headword: {課外授業|かがいじゅぎょう}

definitions.explanation: An educational activity conducted outside the regular curriculum, such as a field trip, special lecture, or supplementary class.

examples.japanese: {課外授業|かがいじゅぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: To take part in an extracurricular lesson.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{課外授業|かがいじゅぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{農場|のうじょう}→農場：20586_noujou⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧だ。
examples.english: Today's extracurricular lesson is a visit to a farm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧{課外授業|かがいじゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The school holds an extracurricular lesson on local history every year.

notes:
A learning activity held outside the standard timetable and curriculum — field trips, guest lectures, nature observation, and the like. ⟦{課外|かがい}→課外：27204_kagai⟧ means 'outside the (regular) coursework.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {課外授業|かがいじゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold an extracurricular lesson
- {課外授業|かがいじゅぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to take part in an extracurricular lesson

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{課外活動|かがいかつどう}→課外活動：08605_kagaikatsudou⟧: extracurricular activities — broader; includes club activities
- ⟦{校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}→校外学習：19055_kougaigakushuu⟧: off-campus study; field trip — learning conducted away from the school grounds
